The '''Mining Fields''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. It was the primary [[Mining/Legends|mining]] area of the [[Mensix Mining Company]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:MF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mining Fields appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mining Fields were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:MF" />
